keyPoints.en: Letter: address → date → Dear … → body → Yours lovingly, name
keyPoints.hi: पत्र: पता → तारीख़ → Dear … → मुख्य भाग → Yours lovingly, नाम

keyPoints.en: Diary: day, date, time → Dear Diary → events and feelings (past tense)
keyPoints.hi: डायरी: दिन, तारीख़, समय → Dear Diary → घटनाएँ और भावनाएँ (past tense)

keyPoints.en: Story: use a catchy opening and a clear ending.
keyPoints.hi: कहानी: आकर्षक शुरुआत और साफ़ अंत।

problem.en: Write a diary entry about your first day at a new school (4–5 lines).
problem.hi: नए स्कूल में पहले दिन पर डायरी लिखो (4–5 पंक्तियाँ)।

steps.en: Start with the date and "Dear Diary".
steps.hi: तारीख़ और "Dear Diary" से शुरू करो।

steps.en: Write what happened and how you felt.
steps.hi: लिखो क्या हुआ और कैसा लगा।

answer.en: Monday, 3 April — Dear Diary, today was my first day at Green Valley School. I was nervous in the morning. My teacher was kind and I made a friend named Kabir. We played football at recess. I think I will like this school! — Anu
answer.hi: Monday, 3 April — Dear Diary, today was my first day at Green Valley School. I was nervous in the morning. My teacher was kind and I made a friend named Kabir. We played football at recess. I think I will like this school! — Anu

problem.en: How do you begin and end a letter to your grandmother?
problem.hi: दादी को पत्र कैसे शुरू और ख़त्म करोगे?

steps.en: Greeting uses "Dear"; closing is warm and personal.

answer.en: Begin: Dear Grandma, End: Yours lovingly, Riya
answer.hi: शुरुआत: Dear Grandma, अंत: Yours lovingly, Riya

question.en: Which tense is mostly used in a diary entry?
What comes right after the address in a letter?
question.hi: पत्र में पते के ठीक बाद क्या आता है?

question.en: Name three things every story needs.
question.hi: हर कहानी में कौन-सी तीन चीज़ें चाहिए?

intro.en: An informal letter is written to family and friends: address, date, greeting (Dear …), body and closing (Yours lovingly, name). A diary entry records your day and feelings: date, "Dear Diary", what happened and how you felt. A story needs characters, a problem and a solution.
intro.hi: अनौपचारिक पत्र परिवार और दोस्तों को लिखते हैं: पता, तारीख़, अभिवादन (Dear …), मुख्य भाग और समापन (Yours lovingly, नाम)। डायरी में दिन और भावनाएँ लिखते हैं: तारीख़, "Dear Diary", क्या हुआ और कैसा लगा। कहानी में पात्र, समस्या और समाधान चाहिए।
